newsitem.title: USA: Lamar says to acquire Outdoor East LP.
newsitem.headline: Lamar says to acquire Outdoor East LP.

text.p: Lamar Advertising Co said it agreed to acquire all of the assets of Outdoor East LP for $60 million in cash.
In this latest acquisition, Lamar will acquire 1,780 posters and 2,070 bulletins in six southeastern states.
The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including required regulatory approvals.

In other acquisition-related activity, Lamar said it recently acquired 50 bulletins in Roanoke, Virginia for approximately $1 million from Colonial Outdoor Advertising Inc and 121 bulletins in Lakeland, Florida from Walz Marketing Inc for approximately $0.8 million.
